title: Regular -ir and -re Verbs
subtitle: finir: je finis, tu finis, il finit, nous finissons, vous finissez, ils finissent. vendre: je vends, tu vends, il vend, nous vendons, vous vendez, ils vendent.
objectives: Conjugate regular -ir verbs (finir pattern) in the present indicative.
Conjugate regular -re verbs (vendre pattern) in the present indicative.
Distinguish between the three regular conjugations: -er, -ir, -re.

sections.heading: Regular -ir verbs
sections.body:
The second conjugation consists of verbs ending in -ir. The pattern is illustrated by finir (to finish).

             finir (to finish)

  je         fin-is      [fini]
  tu         fin-is      [fini]
  il/elle    fin-it      [fini]
  nous       fin-issons  [finisɔ̃]
  vous       fin-issez   [finise]
  ils/elles  fin-issent  [finis]

The singular forms sound identical: [fini]. The plural forms insert -iss- before the ending.

sections.heading: Regular -re verbs
sections.body:
The third conjugation consists of verbs ending in -re. The pattern is illustrated by vendre (to sell).

             vendre (to sell)

  je         vend-s      [vɑ̃]
  tu         vend-s      [vɑ̃]
  il/elle    vend        [vɑ̃]
  nous       vend-ons    [vɑ̃dɔ̃]
  vous       vend-ez     [vɑ̃de]
  ils/elles  vend-ent    [vɑ̃d]

Notice that the third-person singular has no ending: 'il vend', not 'il vends'.

sections.heading: Other common -ir and -re verbs
sections.body:
-ir verbs:
  choisir (to choose): je choisis, tu choisis, il choisit, nous choisissons, vous choisissez, ils choisissent
  réussir (to succeed): je réussis, tu réussis, il réussit, nous réussissons, vous réussissez, ils réussissent

-re verbs:
  attendre (to wait): j'attends, tu attends, il attend, nous attendons, vous attendez, ils attendent
  répondre (to answer): je réponds, tu réponds, il répond, nous répondons, vous répondez, ils répondent

items.prompt: What is inserted in the plural forms of -ir verbs?

items.answer: No. Third-person singular -re verbs have no ending.

sections.heading: Up next
sections.body: Lesson 2.7 covers être and avoir, the two auxiliary verbs. Irregular and mandatory.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you can conjugate three -ir verbs and three -re verbs in the present tense.
